rootCause.description: The homepage fetched Current Board state but built pickPlan and card contracts only from dashboard/today selectors and sections. When Today scalar or selector fields were sparse, rendered cards could ignore current stored board evidence.

summary: pickPlan now accepts Current Board client state.
Current Board candidates are normalized into PlanPick rows for homepage cards.
Daily Brief Predictions, Value Candidates, and Snapshot captured use Current Board evidence when Today fields are zero or missing.
Non-official Current Board rows remain explicitly policy-blocked/review-only.
repair.policySafety: Current Board evidence can populate cards but cannot bypass existing Official Pick or recommendation gates.

validation.legacyValidators: PASS except older release changed-file guards that intentionally reject this bounded homepage file

nextRecommendedPhase: Publish the bounded homepage client-state repair, deploy, and perform read-only production certification that rendered homepage cards no longer show false no-games states when Current Board evidence exists.
